turns.doctor_question: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Well, I guess... I mean, I didn't really decide to come here on my own, they kind of made me. It’s all because of work, down at the freight warehouse. I started there after I took some time off from my college classes, just moving material, loading pallets, that kind of thing. But it’s... the guys on the floor, the foreman, they just don't understand what I'm doing and they get so worked up about it. 

I guess they brought me in because I keep doing things out there by the loading dock. Like, I’ll be right next to the forklift, and I just... I freeze. I'll just stop completely, with my arms straight up in the air by the machine, and I just hold it there. It's like I'm stuck like that. And when the trucks or the lifts are moving, I start copying the sounds, making the exact beeping noises they make when they back up, and doing all the hand signals the spotters use, just over and over and over again. 

And the boxes... they just want them stacked straight, but I've been moving them in these strange little patterns. It’s like they have to go in these specific shapes, shifting them around into this exact design on the floor. I'll be right in the middle of doing it, getting the pattern right, and everyone on the floor is just yelling and screaming for me to stop, telling me I'm holding up the whole freight line.
